findings.description: Josefa Manuela Abarca Fallas and Juan García Calderón had a son, José Vidal García Abarca, born 22 October 1899 at San Juan de Dios, Desamparados, San José, Costa Rica; the civil birth registration names the parents as Juan García and Manuela Abarca.
